findings.evidence: Apical 4-chamber view showing membranous supramitral ring (white arrow)

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Panel A is a TTE image showing the defining anatomical feature, a membranous supramitral ring, in the context of Shone Complex. B: Panel B shows the physiological consequence (severe stenosis) of the supramitral ring identified in Panel A, confirming the pathology of Shone Complex.

plate_findings.evidence: suprasternal view of the aorta reveals turbulent blood flow in the descending aorta, consistent with CoA

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: This is a pediatric echocardiogram (echo) showing turbulent flow in the descending aorta in a suprasternal view, which is consistent with Coarctation of the Aorta (CoA), a key component of Shone Complex. B: This Doppler ultrasound image shows specific hemodynamic findings (peak velocity 4 m/s, diastolic flow pattern) across a stenosis in the aorta, strongly indicative of aortic coarctation in the context of Shone Complex.

Image (B): Continuous wave doppler across the coarctation segment, presenting a peak velocity of 4 m/s and an extended speed reduction during diastole (diastolic tail).
